RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

THIS LEASE AGREEMENT ("Agreement") is made and entered into as of January 1, 2024, by and between:

LANDLORD: Sunrise Properties LLC, a California limited liability company ("Landlord")
TENANT: Jane Smith ("Tenant")

PROPERTY: 456 Oak Avenue, Apt 2B, San Francisco, CA 94102 ("Premises")

Section 1. TERM
1.1 This lease shall be for a period of twelve (12) months, commencing on January 1, 2024, and terminating on December 31, 2024.
1.2 Upon expiration, this lease shall convert to a month-to-month tenancy unless either party provides sixty (60) days written notice.

Section 2. RENT
2.1 Tenant agrees to pay Landlord the sum of Two Thousand Five Hundred Dollars ($2,500.00) per month as rent for the Premises.
2.2 Rent is due on the first (1st) day of each calendar month.
2.3 A late fee of One Hundred Fifty Dollars ($150.00) shall be assessed for any payment received after the fifth (5th) day of the month.

Section 3. SECURITY DEPOSIT
3.1 Upon execution of this Agreement, Tenant shall deposit with Landlord the sum of Five Thousand Dollars ($5,000.00) as a security deposit.
3.2 The security deposit shall be returned within thirty (30) days of lease termination, less any deductions for damages beyond normal wear and tear.

Section 4. MAINTENANCE AND REPAIRS
4.1 Tenant shall maintain the Premises in good condition.
4.2 Tenant shall promptly notify Landlord of any needed repairs.
4.3 Tenant shall be responsible for all repairs and maintenance of the premises, including plumbing, electrical, and structural issues.

Section 5. PETS
5.1 No pets shall be permitted on the Premises without prior written consent of the Landlord.
5.2 If approved, a non-refundable pet deposit of $500 shall be required.

Section 6. ENTRY BY LANDLORD
6.1 Landlord shall provide at least twenty-four (24) hours written notice before entering the Premises.
6.2 In cases of emergency involving immediate risk to life, safety, or property, Landlord may enter without prior notice.

Section 7. TERMINATION
7.1 Tenant may terminate this lease with sixty (60) days written notice.
7.2 Landlord may terminate this lease with thirty (30) days written notice for any reason.
7.3 In the event of material breach, the non-breaching party may terminate with fifteen (15) days notice and opportunity to cure.

Section 8. GOVERNING LAW
8.1 This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of California.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.

________________________
Sunrise Properties LLC (Landlord)

________________________
Jane Smith (Tenant)
